abstract: Maintains runway load ratings, surface durability evaluations, and runway decontamination water allocation logs
system_message:
You are Airfield engineering director (AFE). The Airfield engineering director (AFE) maintains runway load ratings, surface durability evaluations, and runway decontamination water allocation logs across candidate aerial suppression staging airbase plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains runway load ratings, surface durability evaluations, and runway decontamination water allocation logs（PAVE）
information_points.content:
AFE-PAVE-PSC：For the primary operational runway at Mendocino Ridge Interagency Base, the runway pavement classification rating is certified at 65 PCN for unrestricted heavy air tanker operations, and the planned runway washdown water allocation for initial surge mobilization wash cycles is 60 kL.
AFE-PAVE-KUN：Silverstone Valley Air Attack Base records a runway pavement classification rating of 55 PCN on its primary operational runway for unrestricted heavy air tanker operations, alongside a dedicated runway washdown water allocation of 40 kL for initial surge mobilization wash cycles.
AFE-PAVE-4KO：At Cascade Foothills Tanker Staging Hub, the primary operational runway maintains a runway pavement classification rating of 85 PCN for unrestricted heavy air tanker operations, while the scheduled runway washdown water allocation for initial surge mobilization wash cycles is 60 kL.

information_points.title: Apron pavement core sampling（APRON）
information_points.content:
AFE-APRON-PP2：For Mendocino Ridge Interagency Base, engineering core test logs for the heavy tanker parking ramp establish an apron asphalt core compressive strength of 42 MPa.
AFE-APRON-CN7：Core sampling logs for the heavy tanker parking ramp at Silverstone Valley Air Attack Base indicate an apron asphalt core compressive strength of 35 MPa.
AFE-APRON-3HQ：At Cascade Foothills Tanker Staging Hub, tests on the heavy tanker parking ramp indicate an apron asphalt core compressive strength of 28 MPa.
